steps.prompt: Read the codebase and write a short implementation plan for the feature described in TODO.md to PLAN.md. Do not change any code yet.
Implement the plan in PLAN.md step by step. Keep commits small and focused. Do not ask questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them in PLAN.md.
Run the test suite. Fix every failing test you introduced, then run the tests again until they pass.
Review the diff of this session with fresh eyes: look for bugs, missing edge cases and leftover debug code, and fix what you find.
Write a concise CHANGELOG entry for the work above.
